tasks.title: Essay: Festival Priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
In your English class you have been discussing how to make local festivals more accessible and responsible. Now your teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

Some towns are changing their festivals to reduce environmental impact. What is the most important change to make?

Notes

Write about:

1. reducing waste from food stalls
2. providing free public transport to the event
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Review: Festival Workshop
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted!

Have you attended a workshop at a local festival? We want to hear about your experience. Write a review of a festival workshop you went to.

Describe what the workshop involved and how well it was organised. Did it change your view on the festival's impact? Would you recommend it to other students?

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Article: Festival Volunteers
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a local community website.

Articles wanted!

How can we encourage more young people to volunteer at our town's cultural festival?

We are looking for ideas to attract volunteers. Write an article for our website.

Suggest one way to make volunteering more appealing. Explain how it could benefit the volunteers themselves. Describe one task they might enjoy.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Email: Festival Visit
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Sam.

From: Sam
Subject: Festival visit

Hi,
I'm planning to visit your town during the cultural festival next month. I've heard it's a great event, but I'm also concerned about the environmental impact of large festivals. What is the festival doing to be more sustainable? Also, do you think it's still worth attending? And could you recommend one thing I should definitely see or do?

Thanks a lot!
Sam

Write your email.
